card.name: The word of after impairment
card.fires_on: The word 'of' (or 'and') right after 'impairment' or 'reductions in alertness', mostly in the heading 'Carcinogenesis, Mutagenesis, Impairment of Fertility' and in warnings about impaired central nervous system performance.

modes.label: Fertility heading
modes.description: The word 'of' inside the standard heading 'Impairment of Fertility' after carcinogenesis and mutagenesis.
modes.example: Carcinogenesis, Mutagenesis, Impairment<< of>> Fertility No evidence of carcinogenicity

modes.label: CNS performance warning
modes.description: A linking word after 'additional impairment' or 'reductions in alertness' in alcohol and depressant warnings.
modes.example: Avoid concurrent use of Karbinal ER with alcohol or other central nervous system depressants because additional impairment<< of>> central nervous system performance may occur.

modes.label: Impair verb
modes.description: The verb 'impair' or a space before a day count in other label warnings.
modes.example: Nalbuphine hydrochloride injection may<< impair>> the mental or physical abilities needed to perform
